content: Disability is defined as a physical or mental impairment that significantly limits one or more major life activities. These activities may include basic tasks of daily living (ADLs) such as eating, dressing, or bathing. Additionally, it can involve instrumental activities of daily living (IADLs), which are more complex tasks like managing finances or performing housekeeping duties. The capacity to carry out these activities is a critical measure of functional status, especially in individuals with chronic health conditions such as diabetes.
